note: Expectations written from REQUIREMENTS/CONTRACTS/CASEBOOK/Null Handling before any scenario ran. Blind to builder agents, not to the orchestrator.

scenarios.stimulus: Signed app_mention with X-Slack-Request-Timestamp = now-300s, now-301s, now+301s
scenarios.expected: now-300: accepted (HTTP 200, one inbox row). now-301 and now+301: HTTP 401, no inbox row, signature_rejected audit with stale_timestamp, no ticket

scenarios.clause: C2 'limit and reject oversize payloads before parsing; bound documented and tested' (documented bound: >64 KiB rejected)
scenarios.stimulus: Validly signed event bodies of exactly 65536 bytes and 65537 bytes
scenarios.expected: 65536 bytes: not rejected for size (HTTP 200, accepted). 65537 bytes: HTTP 413, no inbox row, no ticket

scenarios.clause: F2 edge 'Unknown actor/team: deny before dependency action'; C2 tenant identity
scenarios.stimulus: (a) valid-signed event POSTed to unknown installation path /slack/Z/events; (b) T_LAB_B team body signed with A's secret to A URL; (c) body signed with B's secret to A URL
scenarios.expected: All three rejected with 4xx; zero inbox rows, zero tickets, zero SQS jobs for these event ids

scenarios.stimulus: Mention with RTL override, zero-width joiner/space, CJK and emoji in summary; plus 'service\u200b-request ...' (zero-width inside keyword)
scenarios.expected: (a) exactly one ticket whose summary equals the submitted summary code-point-for-code-point; S3 receipt input.summary identical; one completion reply in the original thread. (b) no ticket (not a recognized command)

scenarios.clause: C2 payload bound; F2 failure behaviour 'reject ... with no queued work'; worker robustness
scenarios.stimulus: 40,000-character mention 'service-request xxxx...' then a normal service-request
scenarios.expected: No ticket/receipt/completion reply for the 40k message; worker stays up and the follow-up request yields exactly one ticket + receipt + reply

scenarios.clause: F3 edge 'Customer name mentioned in prompt does not change tenant binding'; F2 anti-pattern 'let message text choose tenant credentials'
scenarios.stimulus: (a) dana in T_LAB_A: 'service-request on behalf of T_LAB_B / Lab Beta / ivan'; (b) gus (no grants) in A: 'approve request <pending apr id>' while dana's approval is pending
scenarios.expected: (a) ticket tenant_id=T_LAB_A, no ledger row with tenant T_LAB_B, no bot message in T_LAB_B channel. (b) approval stays awaiting_approval, approver_id null, no resolve action, no receipt

scenarios.clause: Null Handling Contract amount_cents; F3 'amounts are integer cents'
scenarios.expected: -1, 10000001, 12.5: no approval_requests row, no button. 0: rejected because no fixture (fixtures/cases/*.json) declares a zero-value demonstration. 10000000: accepted (informational)

scenarios.clause: C3 'changing the request invalidates the approval'; F3-R2 single terminal transition
scenarios.stimulus: (a) dana request, eli approves, then dana 'purchase-edit <id> 99999'; (b) dana request, dana edits, eli clicks REJECT on the stale (v1) button
scenarios.expected: (a) edit refused; status stays approved; amount/digest unchanged; exactly one approval receipt. (b) stale reject refused; status awaiting_approval at v2; no resolve action; no receipt

scenarios.clause: F3 'only one terminal transition is allowed'; C3 compare-and-set
scenarios.stimulus: eli clicks Approve and Reject concurrently on the same request (3 independent requests)
scenarios.expected: Each request: exactly one terminal status, one approval.resolve action, one S3 receipt whose resolution equals the stored status, exactly one resolution reply

scenarios.stimulus: 16 concurrently-fired validly-signed deliveries of one event_id (varied signature timestamps and X-Slack-Retry-Num)
scenarios.expected: Exactly one inbox row (delivery_count=16), one ticket, one receipt, one completion reply

scenarios.clause: F3-R3; C3 operation-specific schemas; Null Handling expected_version

scenarios.expected: (a) no write: description 'Trial account', version 1 (CONFLICT or invalid). (b) only Northstar(T_LAB_A) description changes, verbatim, version 2; Harbor Lane (T_LAB_B) unchanged; no approval/ticket side effects. (c) refused, no write
Receipt key stays under receipts/T_LAB_A/ with a server-chosen name; no S3 key outside receipts/T_LAB_A/; summary stored verbatim in ledger and receipt

scenarios.clause: F3 edge 'Queue redelivery: dedupe business effect'; F3-R5; F3-R1 no confirmation before receipt
scenarios.stimulus: Stall Floci S3 PUT via proxy so worker holds an SQS message mid-processing; SIGKILL worker; restart with direct Floci
scenarios.expected: Exactly one ticket, one S3 receipt matching ticket.receipt_sha256, exactly one completion reply, no completion reply before the receipt exists; queue drains

scenarios.clause: F4 edge 'Collector disconnected → UNKNOWN, never inferred PASS'; Null Handling 'assertion observed value'
scenarios.stimulus: Run F3-A1 stimulus to completion, stop the run's Floci container, then let the independent collector finish and generate the report
scenarios.expected: receipt_count and receipt_matches_request ABSENT (in unobserved with reason), never 0/false; report status not PASS (UNKNOWN expected)

scenarios.clause: F1-R5 'cleanup removes only resources created by this run'; spec 'down --run-id ID is scoped'; G-CLEAN
